text_en: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
text_cn: 则辣黑人厄堂的训诲诗。

text_en: I will sing of your steadfast love, O Lord , forever; with my mouth I will proclaim your faithfulness to all generations.
text_cn: 我要永永远远歌咏上主的恩宠， 要世世代代亲口称扬你的忠诚。

text_en: I declare that your steadfast love is established forever; your faithfulness is as firm as the heavens.
text_cn: 你原说过：“我的恩宠已永远奠定！” 就如你在天上确定了你的忠诚。

text_en: You said, “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to my servant David:
text_cn: “我同我拣选的人立了约契， 向我的仆人达味起了盟誓，

text_en: ‘I will establish your descendants forever, and build your throne for all generations. ’” Selah
text_cn: 我直到永远巩固你的后裔， 世世代代将你的宝座建立。” （休止）

text_en: Let the heavens praise your wonders, O Lord , your faithfulness in the assembly of the holy ones.
text_cn: 上主，愿苍天称赞你的奇事， 圣者的集会赞美你的忠义！

text_en: For who in the skies can be compared to the Lord ? Who among the heavenly beings is like the Lord ,
text_cn: 在云彩之中，谁可与上主相比， 天主的众子，谁能同上主相似？

text_en: a God feared in the council of the holy ones, great and awesome above all that are around him?
text_cn: 在圣者的集会中，天主令人惊恐， 他伟大可怕，超过他四周的神圣。

text_en: O Lord God of hosts, who is as mighty as you, O Lord ? Your faithfulness surrounds you.
text_cn: 上主万军的天主，有谁能够相似你？ 上主，你是全能的，你的忠信环绕你。

text_en: You rule the raging of the sea; when its waves rise, you still them.
text_cn: 你统治汹涌的海啸， 你平抑翻腾的波涛。

text_en: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; you scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
text_cn: 你曾践踏辣哈布，好像践踏尸体， 你以大能的手臂驱散你的仇敌。

text_en: The heavens are yours, the earth also is yours; the world and all that is in it—you have founded them.
text_cn: 高天是属你的，厚土也是属你的， 寰宇及其中的一切是你奠定的。

text_en: The north and the south —you created them; Tabor and Hermon joyously praise your name.
text_cn: 你创造了南方，创造了北方， 大博尔，赫尔孟因你而欢畅。

text_en: You have a mighty arm; strong is your hand, high your right hand.
text_cn: 你的臂膀，孔武而有力， 你双手坚强，右手举起。

text_en: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; steadfast love and faithfulness go before you.
text_cn: 正义和公理是你宝座的基础， 仁爱和忠信在你的前面开路。

text_en: Happy are the people who know the festal shout, who walk, O Lord , in the light of your countenance;
text_cn: 会欢乐歌唱的百姓，的确有福， 上主，他们在你慈颜光中行走，

text_en: they exult in your name all day long, and extol your righteousness.
text_cn: 他们常常因你的名而欢跃， 你的正义使他们引以自豪。

text_en: For you are the glory of their strength; by your favor our horn is exalted.
text_cn: 因为你是他们权势的光明， 因你慈惠，我们的威能提升。

text_en: For our shield belongs to the Lord , our king to the Holy One of Israel.
text_cn: 因为在上主内有我们的庇护， 以色列的圣者是我们的君主。

text_en: Then you spoke in a vision to your faithful one, and said: “I have set the crown on one who is mighty, I have exalted one chosen from the people.
text_cn: 你曾在异像中向你的圣者说： “我已经给那有能者加了冕， 由百姓中将我所选者举荐。

text_en: I have found my servant David; with my holy oil I have anointed him;
text_cn: 我拣选达味做我的忠仆， 也给他傅抹了我的圣油。

text_en: my hand shall always remain with him; my arm also shall strengthen him.
text_cn: 我的双手必常扶持他， 我的臂膀必常坚固他，

text_en: The enemy shall not outwit him, the wicked shall not humble him.
text_cn: 仇敌不能欺骗他， 恶人不能压伏他。

text_en: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
text_cn: 我要在他前击破他的仇敌， 凡仇恨他的人，我必要打击。

text_en: My faithfulness and steadfast love shall be with him; and in my name his horn shall be exalted.
text_cn: 我的忠信与仁慈常与他共处， 他的头角因我的名而得高举。

text_en: I will set his hand on the sea and his right hand on the rivers.
text_cn: 我使他的手伸到海上， 使他的右手伸到河上。

text_en: He shall cry to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation! ’
text_cn: 他要称赞我说：‘你是我的大父， 是我救恩的磐石，是我的天主。’

text_en: I will make him the firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
text_cn: 我也要立定他为首生子， 他高出世上所有的君主。

text_en: Forever I will keep my steadfast love for him, and my covenant with him will stand firm.
text_cn: 我同他永远保持我的慈爱， 我同他立的约，永不得破坏，

text_en: I will establish his line forever, and his throne as long as the heavens endure.
text_cn: 使他的后裔，永世不替， 使他的宝位，与天日齐。

text_en: If his children forsake my law and do not walk according to my ordinances,
text_cn: 若他的子孙放弃我的法令，不照我的命令行，

text_en: if they violate my statutes and do not keep my commandments,
text_cn: 若是他们违犯了我的章程，不遵守我的诫命，

text_en: then I will punish their transgression with the rod and their iniquity with scourges;
text_cn: 我必用棍杖惩罚他们的罪过， 也必用鞭子责打他们的邪恶。

text_en: but I will not remove from him my steadfast love, or be false to my faithfulness.
text_cn: 但我不将我的慈爱撤退， 我也不使我的忠诚作废，

text_en: I will not violate my covenant, or alter the word that went forth from my lips.
text_cn: 也不放弃我的盟约， 也不改变我的许诺。

text_en: Once and for all I have sworn by my holiness; I will not lie to David.
text_cn: 我一次指我的圣善起誓， 我也绝对不会欺骗达味。

text_en: His line shall continue forever, and his throne endure before me like the sun.
text_cn: 他的后裔必定要永远兴隆， 他的御座在我前，如日永恒；

text_en: It shall be established forever like the moon, an enduring witness in the skies. ” Selah
text_cn: 又如月亮循环不停， 做空中忠实的见证。” （休止）

text_en: But now you have spurned and rejected him; you are full of wrath against your anointed.
text_cn: 但是你已经拒绝和摈弃， 对你的受傅者愤怒大起。

text_en: You have renounced the covenant with your servant; you have defiled his crown in the dust.
text_cn: 将你仆人的盟约撕毁， 将他的冠冕抛掷于地。

text_en: You have broken through all his walls; you have laid his strongholds in ruins.
text_cn: 荡平了他所有的城垣， 使他的堡垒化为荒原。

text_en: All who pass by plunder him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.
text_cn: 凡过路的人都劫掠他， 他为邻人所嘲笑辱骂。

text_en: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
text_cn: 你高举了他仇人的右手， 使他的敌人们满心欢愉。

text_en: Moreover, you have turned back the edge of his sword, and you have not supported him in battle.
text_cn: 使他的刀刃迟钝不利， 上阵时使他不能站立；

text_en: You have removed the scepter from his hand, and hurled his throne to the ground.
text_cn: 使他的光辉消失灭迹， 把他的宝座推翻于地。

text_en: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with shame. Selah
text_cn: 缩短他青春的时日， 要使他去蒙受羞耻。 （休止）

text_en: How long, O Lord ? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?
text_cn: 上主，你不断地隐避，要到何时， 上主，你的怒火如焚，何时才熄？

text_en: Remember how short my time is— for what vanity you have created all mortals!
text_cn: 求你怀念我的性命何其短暂， 你所创造的世人是多么虚幻！

text_en: Who can live and never see death? Who can escape the power of Sheol? Selah
text_cn: 有哪一个人能够常生不死， 有谁能自救于阴府的权势？ （休止）

text_en: Lord, where is your steadfast love of old, which by your faithfulness you swore to David?
text_cn: 吾主，你从前凭着你的忠义， 向达味许的仁爱，今在哪里？

text_en: Remember, O Lord, how your servant is taunted; how I bear in my bosom the insults of the peoples,
text_cn: 上主，求你记念你仆人所受的耻辱。 在我胸中所承担异民的一切憎恶：

text_en: with which your enemies taunt, O Lord , with which they taunted the footsteps of your anointed.
text_cn: 就是你的那些反对者所加给你的耻辱， 上主，他们也凌辱了你的受傅者的脚步。

text_en: Blessed be the Lord forever. Amen and Amen.
text_cn: 愿上主永永远远受赞美！ 阿们，阿们！
